subject: Security exhibit & pen-test timing — MDX Health
messages:
From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@mdx.health>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: MDX Legal <legal@mdx.health>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit & pen-test timing — MDX Health

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks for sending the MSA + order form over. Our legal team pulled the security exhibit and had a couple of clarifying asks before we route to procurement:

- SOC 2: can Redwood confirm when the latest report will be available (link or date)? MDX needs 90 days currency in order to accept SOC references in the contract.
- Pen test: MDX prefers a 30-day advance notice window for any external penetration test and a 5 business day staging access window. Can Redwood agree to a narrow inspection window and provide an anonymization plan for sampled logs?
- Evidence cadence: we usually expect monthly evidence bundles during onboarding then quarterly thereafter — can you propose a handoff cadence and a single point of contact for evidence requests?

I've attached our initial question set (MDX_Security_Questions.xlsx) — happy to discuss on a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Ethan
Procurement Lead, MDX Health

Attachment: MDX_Security_Questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@mdx.health>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 12:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit & pen-test timing — MDX Health

Ethan — thanks, and appreciated the clear list. I put initial responses inline and attached a marked-up security exhibit (Redlines_MSA_v2.pdf) with suggested language that we think preserves your needs while staying operationally feasible for Redwood.

Inline answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) report was completed 2027-05-10; we can provide a secure read-only link and offer an attestation letter with the order form. Link: https://redwood.app/soc2/2027-type2 (we'll send access post-NDA).
- Pen test notice: We can accept a 30-calendar-day notice for third-party pen-tests when MDX supplies the testing scope and list of IPs. For staged pen tests requiring host-level access, we propose a 7 business-day staging window as a max to ensure our engineering coordination and to avoid customer impact. If MDX requires 5 business days specifically, please confirm and we'll flag it as an exception for this deal.
- Evidence cadence & contact: default is monthly bundles during onboarding (first 3 months) then quarterly; single contact will be Monika Patel (monica.patel@redwood.ai) from Assurance. She'll own evidence delivery and emergency expedited requests.

Next steps: 1) Laura — can you review the attached security exhibit redlines and confirm whether legal can accept the 7 business day staging compromise or if we need to concede 5 business days for MDX? 2) Ben — do we have an anonymization playbook for sampled logs we can share as an exhibit attachment? 3) Ethan / MDX Legal — if those two points are acceptable we'll prepare an assurance addendum and a short SOW clause for pen-test coordination.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m sync if helpful.

— Priyom
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redlines_MSA_v2.pdf (marked-up security exhibit)

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MDX security exhibit redlines — legal / assurance Qs

Laura / Ben / Monika — summarizing our posture before we send an edited assurance addendum to MDX: 

- Staging window: I recommended 7 business days in my reply as a compromise. If Legal prefers to concede to 5 business days for this net-new customer, flag the implications (on-call/resourcing and SRE blackout windows).
- Pen-test scope: MDX may ask for penetration of non-prod and limited-production with sampling. We should require MDX to provide the testing firm details and IP list + statement confirming no customer data exfiltration attempts.
- Evidence: Monika will supply monthly bundles for first 90 days (SOC2 controls mapping, config snapshots, uptime logs) then quarterly. We need an internal runbook link for what gets redacted/anonymized. Ben — please attach the anonymization checklist and the redaction template to the addendum.

Action items:
- Ben: anonymization checklist + example redacted log (due by Thu EOD)
- Laura: advise on legal acceptability of 5 vs 7 business day staging window and any required indemnity language (due Fri morning)
- Monika: draft the evidence cadence paragraph and contact block for the addendum (due Thu)

I'll stitch the changes into Redlines_MSA_v2 and send back to Ethan.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@mdx.health>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: MDX Legal <legal@mdx.health>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit & pen-test timing — MDX Health

Priyom / Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear path. MDX Legal reviewed the redlines and has two small asks before we can finalize: 

1) We can accept the 7 business day staging window only if Redwood confirms that sampled logs will be anonymized to remove patient identifiers and that MDX will get a redacted example prior to the first scheduled evidence bundle.
2) On pen-tests: MDX will supply the testing vendor name and IP list and expects a joint pre-test call; additionally, they want a clause that the pen-test report can be provided to MDX's security team under NDA within 30 days of test completion.

If Redwood can confirm items (1) and (2), MDX is willing to sign the order form with the assurance addendum. We attached a signed stub of the order form for reference.

Thanks — happy to get this wrapped this week.

Best,
Ethan
Procurement Lead, MDX Health

Attachment: MDX_Signed_OrderForm_stub.pdf (PDF stub)
